name: Molten Slagheap
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Put a storage counter on this land.
{1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
blocked_sentences: {1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.

needs.what: a cost that removes an announced X counters of a named kind from the source ("Remove X storage counters from this land"), X chosen on activation from 0 up to the counters present and readable by the ability's effects as {"x": ...}, usable on a mana ability so add_mana's `amount` with `split: ["B", "R"]` can produce X mana
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `remove_counters` cost takes a fixed integer `amount` (Cost.remove_counters is priced and paid with int(amount)); `cost_x_ceiling` announces X only for discard_x, sacrifice_x and tap_x, and loyalty_x is loyalty-only. There is no remove_counters_x, so the X cannot be announced or bounded by storage counters. The other two lines (`{T}: Add {C}.` and `{1}, {T}: Put a storage counter` via add_counters) are expressible.
